FIRST ADDENDUM
to Rating Agreement dated

30th April , 2020

This First Addendum (“First Addendum”) is entered into on this 30th day of
and between:

April , 2020, by

The Pakistan Credit Rating Agency Limited (“PACRA”) and Zameen Venture One (Private)
Limited (“Client”)
[Each also a “Party” and, collectively, “Parties”]

WHEREAS, the Parties entered into the Rating Agreement dated [ day] [ month] [ year]
whereby PACRA undertook to complete the rating assignment from the Client on the terms and
conditions as set out in the Rating Agreement (“Rating Agreement”); and
AND WHEREAS, the Parties intend to amend and add to the Rating Agreement, as per the terms
hereof, subject to applicable laws.
NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows:
1. Following Clause shall be inserted after Clause 37 under ‘Section K: General Terms’ in the
Rating Agreement:
“If either Party fails to fulfil its obligations hereunder when such failure arises out of or is caused,
directly or indirectly, by circumstances beyond its reasonable control, including, without limitation,
acts of God; earthquakes; fires; floods; storms; or other natural forces; wars (declared and
undeclared); revolution; civil or military unrest; change in any law or regulation; acts of terrorism;
sabotage; strikes, lockouts or other labor disturbances; embargoes; epidemics; pandemic; riots;
insurrections and any such circumstances beyond its reasonable control, then said failure shall
not be considered a default of obligations hereunder for the duration of such event, and for such
time thereafter as is reasonable to enable the affected Party or Parties to resume performance
under this Rating Agreement. Provided however, that in no event shall such time extend for a
period of more than thirty (30) days. The Party prevented from carrying out its obligations
(“Affected Party”) shall give notice to the other Party of an event of force majeure upon it being
foreseen by, or becoming known to, the Affected Party. Provided further that nothing in this clause
shall allow either Party any extension of time with respect to its statutory obligations under the
Credit Rating Agencies Regulations 2016, except as permitted by law.”
2. This First Addendum shall be read as an integral part of the Rating Agreement.
3. All other terms and provisions in the Rating Agreement shall remain unaffected and shall
continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the event

of any conflict, the provisions of this First Addendum shall prevail, and any conflicting term in
the Rating Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately.
4. All expressions and terms defined or used in the Rating Agreement shall bear the same
meaning in this First Addendum, unless otherwise specified.
5. This First Addendum may be entered into in counterparts, all of which taken together
shall constitute one and the same addendum.

SIGNATORIES
FIRST ADDENDUM TO THE RATING AGREEEMENT

This First Addendum has been entered into on the date stated at the beginning of this First
Addendum.
